opening.argument: The strongest evidence presents Forsage as an easy work-from-home income opportunity, not as an ordinary job or a clearly described product. The speaker says, “After staying at home, you can build this business easily,” while the title advertises “work from home, online income, no product, 💯% income.” The displayed account structure reinforces a recruitment-based model: it shows “Partners 11” and “Team 32,” alongside a profits figure of 772.1 BUSD. The video also promotes “monthly income” with a stated minimum of 20,000. Together, these personal and minimum-income claims encourage participation by presenting accessible earnings through a multi-person structure.
